description: This PHP class file defines an implementation of an issue tracker interface for Tuleap REST API integration in a test management system. It includes methods for connection handling, issue retrieval, status management, and issue creation, with configuration templates and validation functions.

classes.name: tuleaprestInterface
classes.description: A PHP class implementing the test issue tracker interface for Tuleap via REST API, handling connection, issue management, status configuration, and API integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configuration, verifies tracker ID and URL, then connects to the Tuleap API.

methods.name: checkTrackerIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates that a tracker ID consists only of digits and is greater than zero.

methods.name: checkURLSyntax
methods.description: Checks if a URL is valid and starts with 'http' or 'https'.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object used for Tuleap API communication.

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg
methods.description: Sets up the list of resolved statuses from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: getResolvedStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of resolved statuses from Tuleap for the tracker.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Fetches a specific field from a tracker object by field ID.

methods.name: getClosedLabels
methods.description: Extracts labels for closed status values from the tracker.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates whether a bug ID has proper numeric format.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Tuleap API using provided credentials.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the API connection has been established.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Builds an HTML string representing the issue status, striking through if the status indicates closure.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of an issue from Tuleap by its ID, adding HTML formatted strings.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose, possibly HTML-formatted, status string for an issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template XML configuration for the Tuleap issue tracker integration.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration by setting default API URLs if missing.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Verifies if an issue with the given ID exists on Tuleap.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Tuleap with a summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing Tuleap issue.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates if issue creation via API is possible based on tracker ID availability.
